history.sg_progress: The Administration takes note of the recommendations in paragraphs 189 and 191 of the Board’s report. The Administration therefore does not see the point of this recommendation or on what criteria it could be considered by the Board as implemented in the future, owing not only to its ongoing nature, but also to the fact that the recommendation in paragraph 189 has been accepted and is under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: 15. The Board recommends that the Administration review posts that have been vacant or filled temporarily for two years or more and propose either their abolishment or their retention, including a clear and detailed justification in the next budget proposal.
history.reference_raw: A/75/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the period ended; para. 191
history.administration_response: The Administration stated that the current procedure established a solid framework for the review of posts vacant for two years or more. In their budget submissions, missions provided a summary of posts that have been vacant for a long period of time to demonstrate compliance with regard to those posts having been reviewed and considered for retention, abolishment or other post action. If posts were to be retained, information should be provided on the status of recruitment at the time of budget preparation, as well as clear justification of the need for retention. This information was updated several times during the budget proposal process.
history.board_assessment: The Board considers this recommendation as implemented.
